## F.5 Findings

Severity 3 a row red in both preview runs or a feature that does not do what FEATURES.md says, 2 a defect a seller meets, 1 cosmetic or a recorded flake. Owners as FEATURES.md section 6 spells them; the integrator where the file is nobody's. Every mechanism below was read by hand on the deployment of record in the seller's browser (Chrome for Testing 151 with ANGLE Metal on the Apple M5 Max, the same renderer string the audits' Glyphfield reference ran on) and, where it says so, in the runner's headless shell (SwiftShader).

1. **F1, severity 3, B5 (`packages/viewer/src/MaterialMount.tsx` `hostFor` and the play plan; the CSS rule `.ts-sheet .material > canvas` in `packages/render/src/block-css.ts` is B3's).** The live canvas is never visible once the block has a frame. `hostFor` mounts Paper's canvas into the block's `.material` box before the frame `<img>`, Paper's own `shader-mount.js` styles the canvas `z-index: -1`, and the image stays in flow above it, so in every state the element at the block's centre is `img.material-frame` (read with `elementFromPoint` at rest, with View > Play shaders On and Off). Since the client capture lands a frame 2 to 3 s after every insert or change, the selected block shows the still from then on: the Amplitude drag moved the value 3.2 to 5.6 with the range scrolled into view and changed 0.0 percent of the box's pixels in every context (the release wrote one revision and Cmd+Z restored the value, so the gesture itself holds), a click on the Chrome tile wrote `/preset` and changed nothing on the stage 559 to 772 ms later until the re-captured image loaded about 3 s on, and with View > Play shaders On two clips 900 ms apart were identical bytes. This is the mechanism under `shaders.panel.slider-live-undo` (red in both runs; integrator finding 16 named the driver's scroll, which this pass's drive rules out) and `shaders.panel.preset-tiles` (finding 18), and it makes the editor half of 5.6 unobservable. The fix is one of two: the mount hides `.material > img` while it holds a live handle for a `play` plan (and shows it again on dispose), or the canvas is placed above the image. Pictures `features-two-shader-section-*`, `features-two-shader-captured-*`.
2. **F2, severity 3, B7 with the integrator (`apps/studio/vite.deploy.config.ts`; `packages/materials/src/capture.ts` `paperDistDir`).** Every hosted render path refuses on the deployment because the function cannot load Paper: `shader.render` through the window transport answers `Cannot find module '@paper-design/shaders'` in about 140 ms, and `shader.capture`, `slide.setBackgroundMaterial` and the Background dialog's Place all answer the one sentence "The frame could not be rendered. Try again, or place the shader without a frame" in 139 to 956 ms for liquid metal, gem smoke and god rays alike (six of six Place attempts across the four contexts, the button reading "Placing" without a number). `capture.ts` resolves Paper's dist directory at run time (`createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('@paper-design/shaders')`, line 152) to serve the capture page and to read the noise texture, and the function's bundle carries neither the package nor its dist under `PACKAGES_PATTERN` (which B7 extended for the stills alone). The consequences: `shaders.agent.list-insert-set-render` red in both runs (finding 24's cause, read here), the WebGL-less fallback of 5.5 dead on the deployment, and Change background > Shader unusable (the ground never changes), which is what a seller meets. `shaders.background.place-answers` still reads green in both runs and by the walk's text because the row's interaction accepts "one sentence names the failure" as a pass; the row measures the dialog's manners, not that Place works, and the ship note should not read it as the feature working. `shaders.panel.one-home`'s second clause (the dialog's options link) fails as a consequence: with no ground placed the link is absent.
3. **F3, severity 2, B5 (`packages/chrome/src/inspector/shader.tsx`).** The three sliders the featured entry does not use (Strength, Detail and Grain on liquid metal) are drawn disabled and show no tooltip at all, where the row and a seller expect the sentence and "not used by this shader": 8 of 11 sentences in every context; the other eight read their sentence. Integrator finding 17, confirmed by hand.
4. **F4, severity 2, B4 with B5 (`scripts/probes/core-walk/areas/shaders.mjs`, the kit colours step; `apps/studio/src/server` `deck.info`'s `defaults.appearance`).** `shaders.panel.kit-colours` is red in both runs on a write of the appearance the deck does not render. A `/new` deck on the deployment renders light whatever the chrome's appearance (the sheet is white in every dark context picture), and by hand `brand.set /colors/light/primary` re-coloured the shader and re-keyed its frame in 2.7 to 4.1 s in every context while `brand.set /colors/dark/primary` left it unchanged after 8.4 to 9.1 s; the six swatches read text, background, caption, hint, primary, accent and Custom with the role's sentence in the tooltip, and a click on Primary wrote the role's preset and re-keyed the frame in 2.8 to 3.5 s. The walk writes the appearance `t.appearance().deck` answers (`deck.info` `defaults.appearance`, else the state's theme), which on the preview read dark for a deck drawn light; either the read or the record is wrong, and the product's own path passes.
5. **F5, severity 2, B4 (`apps/studio/e2e/core/export.spec.ts`, `lib.ts` `largestPdfImage` and `sampleClip`).** `shaders.export.pdf-frame` is red in both runs and `shaders.export.html-frame` red once on the samplers alone: opened with poppler, the PDF of every context carries one image object of 3200 by 1734 FlateDecode on the shader's page and no label text, and the page rasterized at 1600 by 900 reads a mean colour over the block's box within 10.5 to 13.2 per channel of the frame file's own (F.8). The frame is in the file; the reader does not decode the hosted file's encoding (integrator finding 23). By 7.2 as written the export row blocks the ship until the reader reads it green twice; the product's claim holds.
6. **F6, severity 1, B4 (`shaders.mjs`, the insert row's kind clause; `e2e/core/shaders.spec.ts`, the frame count and the id derivation).** Three driver contracts red in both runs whose product claims hold by hand: `shaders.insert.selected-free-rectangle` (the block lands at 646,129 480 by 272, selected with the chip Shader, eight handles and the rotation handle, over no text box, in 221 to 473 ms; the slide's kind reads title then content, as every object insert converts a layout slide, integrator finding 1); `shaders.frame.auto-capture` (the frame lands 2.2 to 5.2 s after the insert or the release with `backend: 'client'`, the renderer string and the id `frame-<16 hex of the key>`, the spec keeping the `sha256:` prefix, finding 20); `shaders.frame.reuse-and-prune` and `shaders.frame.one-capturer` (Cmd+Z after a capture puts the block back on its earlier asset with no new asset 2 s later; a second editor's `shader.set` made its frame in 3.2 to 3.9 s, this tab drew it and sent no `shader.frame` request, and the deck held one `frame-` asset beside the layout's `opener-prototemplate` material picture the spec counts as a second frame, finding 22).
7. **F7, severity 1, B5 (`scripts/build-shader-previews.mjs`).** The preset tiles under a gallery card render in each preset's colours (the Primary and Accent blues, gem smoke's fire) while the sentence over the grid says the previews are black and white; the cards are. Integrator finding 8, read in every context. Picture `features-two-gallery-*`.
8. **F8, severity 1, B4 with B7 (`e2e/core/shaders.spec.ts`).** The two P1 show rows (`shaders.show.plays-when-on`, `shaders.show.frame-when-off`) assert a canvas and a frame on the absent present layer and count as red where the other P1 rows count as not driven (integrator finding 13); by hand the show draws the frame (a 3200 px picture, no canvas, no label words) and its Options menu lists Play shaders with In the show only checked, the same three rows as View > Play shaders.

## F.1 Verdict

The tree does not ship as it stands under FEATURES.md 7.2, and the distance is short and named. What the two preview runs of this pass say, read by id from the run JSON (walk 1 17:46:48Z, specs 1 17:54:21Z, cost 1 18:18:04Z; walk 2 18:38:56Z, specs 2 18:44:49Z, cost 2 19:07:07Z; one deployment, no code change between them; retries zero; the walk's 14 shaders rows, the specs' 53 rows and the 6 cost rows each time):

By 7.2 the row parks the shader library whole until the fix round turns it. `shaders.panel.one-home` (B5 with the integrator, request R13 of `b5.md`: three hunks in `packages/chrome/src/FormatOptions.tsx`) is red in both runs and on 4419 (F.5 F2): parks `formatOptions.shader`.

## F.5 Findings

Severity 3 a row red in both preview runs or a feature that does not do what FEATURES.md says, 2 a defect a seller meets, 1 cosmetic or a recorded flake. Owners as FEATURES.md section 6 spells them; the integrator where the file is nobody's. Every mechanism was read by hand on this pass's preview in the seller's browser (Chrome for Testing 151, ANGLE Metal) or from a run's JSON by row id, as each item says.

1. **F1, severity 3, B5 with B7 (`packages/materials/src/capture.ts` `renderMaterialFrames`, request R1 of `build/b7.md`).** `shaders.agent.list-insert-set-render` is red in both preview runs without `parks`: `shader.list`, `shader.insert` and `shader.set` answer 200 and `shader.render` answers 500 in 12.5 and 9.0 s (`application/json`, no bytes). B7's hunk holds (check step 30 traces Paper and the function carries its dist; no reading of this pass says "Cannot find module"), and the second half B7 named is unchanged on the tree: the capture context is closed in the `finally` of `renderMaterialFrames` (line 409) and the single-process serverless shell dies on that close (`docs/hosting-chromium.md` 3b), so every hosted render path answers the one sentence after its capture ran. By hand it is what a seller meets: Change background > Shader > Place reads "Placing, 8 s" to "Placing, 13 s" and answers "The frame could not be rendered. Try again, or place the shader without a frame" in every context, no ground is placed, and `shader.render` through the window API refuses with `browserContext.close: Target page, context or browser has been closed`. By 7.2 a red `shaders.*` row without `parks` parks the shader library whole until the fix round turns it; R1 is one line (`if (!isSingleProcessBrowser(browser)) await context.close().catch(() => undefined)`) with its test named in `b7.md`, and the row passed twice on the checkout (B7's 4417 runs; this pass's 4419 specs read it green too). `shaders.background.place-answers` still reads green in every run while Place fails, as pass 1 F.10 item 3 says. Pictures `features-two-p2-background-shader-placed-*`.
2. **F2, severity 3 by the rule, B5 with the integrator (`packages/chrome/src/FormatOptions.tsx`, request R13 of `build/b5.md`) and B7 (R1).** `shaders.panel.one-home` is red in both preview runs and on 4419: the first clause holds (Pictures and materials lists the Pictures section alone with the switch on) and the second cannot be read on the preview, the Background dialog's options link being absent because no ground is ever placed (F1); on 4419, where the ground is placed through the checkout's Chrome, the link opens Format options with no Shader section for the covering picture, because B5's `GroundSection` is on the tree and its mount in `FormatOptions.tsx` (the import, the filter and the render of R13) is not. Parks `formatOptions.shader` by the mechanical list until R1 and R13 land.
3. **F3, severity 3 by the rule, B4 (`scripts/probes/core-walk/areas/shaders.mjs`, the `slider-live-undo` step).** `shaders.panel.slider-live-undo` is red in both preview runs and on 4419 on the driver's own read: the step reads the thumb's point off the Amplitude range without scrolling the control into view and, on this build's panel at 900 px, the range sits below the fold, so the drag moves over nothing, the value reads 3.2 to 3.2, no revision is written and the step's Cmd+Z takes the last write before it. B5's fix round note named the scroll to B4 (its `control-sentences` step scrolls each control first); the fix round did not change the step. The product's gesture holds by hand in every context with the range scrolled into view (F.6): the live canvas changes 1.7 to 5.6 percent of the box's pixels during the drag with nothing written, the release writes one revision, Cmd+Z restores the value and the box in one step. Parks `formatOptions.shader.strength` by the mechanical list.
4. **F4, severity 3 by the rule, B4 (`shaders.mjs`, the `preset-tiles` step).** `shaders.panel.preset-tiles` is red in both preview runs on the driver's threshold: the step clicks `preset.ink-paper` (Diamond to Ink on paper, two black and white presets of one geometry) and waits 500 ms for a mean luminance move over 20 or 30 percent of pixels changed; the click wrote `/preset` in one revision and the canvas changed 6 percent of its pixels with the mean moved 10.0, read at 1,048 ms once the poll gave up. By hand a click on Chrome changes 93 to 94 percent of the box's pixels with the mean moved 262 to 263, read 81 to 83 ms after the click, in every context (pass 1 F1's second consequence is fixed). Parks `formatOptions.shader.preset` by the mechanical list.
5. **F5, severity 2, B5 (`packages/materials/src/presets.ts` `shaderPaletteOfDeck` with `packages/schema/src/deck.ts` `deckAppearance`) and B4 (the kit step's note).** On a deck opened from `/new` under the dark chrome the stage is painted dark (`data-theme="dark"` on `.ts-stagewrap.ts-editor`, the chrome's `useTheme()` handed to `StageEditor` in `EditorRoot.tsx` 1817; the `deckAppearance` at line 1777 B4's note cites is the layout plate's), `deck.info` reports `defaults.appearance: "light"` (the default kit's, `server/write.ts` 471 to 476), and the shader's palette follows the deck record: `brand.set /colors/dark/primary` changed neither the live canvas nor the frame after 9.3 and 14.3 s while `brand.set /colors/light/primary` re coloured the shader on the dark stage and re keyed its frame in 3.9 s (`hand/probe-kit-p2.mjs`, both drives' dark contexts, picture `features-two-p2-kit-colour-changed-dark-1440` with the Primary swatch still the light kit's blue). So a seller in the dark chrome edits the light kit's roles on a stage drawn dark, and the walk's fixed kit step writes the chrome's theme off the stage (right on the light runner by coincidence, where the row read green on the frame's re key 5,061 ms after the write against its 5 s bound and the block's mean colour moved 2.5 on the ink-paper preset the preset step left; not driven in run 2 once the slider step's Cmd+Z took the block). Pass 1 F4's record that the sheet renders light in the dark contexts was wrong; pass 1's own dark pictures show it dark.
6. **F6, severity 3 by the rule, B4 (`apps/studio/e2e/core/shaders.spec.ts`, the auto capture row's card read).** `shaders.frame.auto-capture` failed in preview run 1 on its last clause alone, "the filmstrip card shows the frame": 17 reads over 10,089 ms answered no sample (`cardDistance` null), while every product clause read green (the frame `frame-84edcc2f3315d0b2` 1,576 ms after the change, `backend: 'client'`, the renderer string, the id `frame-<16 hex of the key>`, 3200 by 1814 through the assets route's redirect). Run 2 read the same: every product clause green (the frame `frame-84edcc2f3315d0b2` 2 ms after the change, the key's asset reused), the card read null after 17 reads over 10,014 ms. Red in both runs, so the mechanical list parks `insert.shader`, on a read the product never fails: the card never yields a sample to the driver, which B4 reads first.
7. **F7, severity 3 by the rule, B4 (`shaders.mjs`, the `one-context` step's 500 ms bound) with B5.** `shaders.perf.one-context` failed in preview run 1 on the swap's time alone: one canvas on the stage in every state, the second's root 1 canvas and the first's 0 with its frame decoded, the swap read 878 ms after the click against 500 with the machine at load 35 (check step 5 and the vector pipeline's runs beside the walk); by hand the swap read 387 to 440 ms in every context. Run 2 read red on other clauses under the slider step's cascade (the first block gone, the page count 2 with the first selected, the swap 537 ms). Red in both runs, so the mechanical list parks `insert.shader`; the product's plan holds by hand (one canvas in every state, the swap 387 to 440 ms, F.6).
8. **F8, severity 2, B5 with the integrator (`packages/viewer/src/shader-frame.ts`, `apps/studio/src/editor/controller.tsx` the frame write's base; B4's request of `build/b4.md` section 4, not answered in the fix round).** On the memory tier the client's frames do not land: the 4419 specs read `shaders.frame.auto-capture`, `box-aspect`, `reuse-and-prune` and `one-capturer` red on "no frame after the recipe change" and the dev log carries the server's refusals of the client's `shader.frame` writes, six times "the block's recipe moved on since the frame was drawn (its key is no longer the frame's)" and twice `No block "material" on slide "title-1"`; the same drivers read the client's frames 1.3 to 2.6 s after a change on the preview (run 1: box-aspect 2,642 ms, the reuse 1,914 then 1,288 ms, the prune to one asset). The checkout's reading of the frame rows is therefore not the product's, and a contributor's `pnpm check` step 32 reads four shader rows red on it.
9. **F9, severity 1, this pass's hosted smoke.** `node scripts/hosted-smoke.mjs` at 17:46:15Z read 39 of 40: the `/decks` row answered 200 in 7,740 ms with 11 cards and no `data-deck="gt-brand"` on the cold instance; a direct read of `/decks` with the OIDC header at 18:1xZ listed 76 cards with `gt-brand` among them, and the smoke re run at the end read 40 of 40 at 19:37:20Z.

Not in the fix round's four findings for B5, not touched. Pictures `features-two-p2-shader-section-*`.
11. **F11, severity 1, a note on the readings.** Under load 35 (the 1440 light drive beside the preview walk and check step 5) the deployment acknowledged this tab's commits slowly: three steps read the revision unchanged 6 s after a write that later landed, and no re capture came within 11 to 24 s after the preset and kit clicks, where the other three contexts read 3.6 to 4.1 s; the same tab drew the second editor's frame 4.2 s after its write. Recorded as the environment's reading, not a defect; the bursts of the regression set are the write latency's reading of record (F.2).

## VP.1 Verdict

The round holds on production: 827 rows, 780 passed, 25 failed, 22 not driven (1 manual), 0 no step, `retries` zero, 10,435 s (01:22:16Z to 04:16:11Z on 2026-09-26), and every row of the round reads green on production in the run of record or in the once rerun. 43 of the round's 44 rows were green in the run of record, every walk row of the round on the first try; `svg.render.vector-at-zoom` read red once with the preview's reading (the sheet at 100 and 200 percent and the show drawing the svg, the viewer without the picture at revision 23 right after the row's own writes, the blob tier's timing class) and green on the rerun, and `shapes.geometry.export.raster-modes` red once on its first download's 60 s bound and green on the rerun (VP.3). `svg.copy.markup`, the second row part A left to this gate, passed in the run of record with the markup and the envelope on the clipboard and the paste landing a second picture, so its preview red was the harness's header on the store host's redirect as the ship json recorded, and `picture.svg.copy` stays in the default view. Nothing of the round parks; the parked list `ship-ea332aa.json` stands as shipped, and `packages/chrome/src/parked-controls.ts` and the `advanced` flags are untouched. Eleven of the twenty five reds and every one of the twenty two not driven rows are the parked list's, the parked features', the P1 rows', the fixture rows', the environment's or by design, as the hotfix's table. Kevin's two standing rows both read red (`decks.file.open-list-search` twice, `sync.title.concurrent-both-kept` once, green on the rerun) and are never chased. Of the earlier rounds' core rows, eight read red once and green on the rerun and are recorded flaky in their classes; six read red in the rerun alone in the blob tier's bound classes; one is red in both production readings and is named as the blocker, never hidden: `decks.file.make-a-copy`, the copy refused with "decks/northwind-renewal-v4-without-notes exists already; pick another name" because the spec's fixed fixture id sits in the shared store from another lane's run since 20:55Z on 2026-09-25 (VP.3, VP.6), the reading the hotfix's table recorded green once the leftover was gone. The two cost rows over their ceiling once in the run of record (`cost.editor-editing.calls`, store simple 175 a minute against 140 with four instances answering; `cost.two-tabs-idle.calls`, one store `list` against none) read under their ceilings on the rerun once (simple 92 with one instance; `list` 0), the instance spread of the blob tier and not the round's code, which adds no function request (9.66 idle and 68.92 editing to the second decimal, as the hotfix and the preview read) (VP.4). ## V.5 Findings

Severity 3 a row broken or a feature that does not do what OBJECTS.md says, 2 a defect a seller meets, 1 cosmetic or a recorded flake. Owners as OBJECTS.md 5.1 names them.

1. **Severity 3, B2 (the autofit's scope, OBJECTS.md 3.3 item 3) with the integrator (`packages/chrome/src/editor-shell.ts` 3070 to 3100, the shell's route) and B4 (a row).** A row added by any path but the "+" leaves the table's `pos.h` where it was, so the new row draws under the ring and the eight squares stay on the old box: Insert row below from the cell's right click menu (and Insert row above and Insert column right, the same route from Format > Table) took the filled 3 by 3 table to 4 rows with `pos.h` 163 to 163 and the rows drawn 53, 53, 53, 53 (the last row's bottom 216 px under the table's top against the 163 px ring; `vector-objects-p1-table-menu-insert-row-*.png`, `-table-added-*.png`: the fourth row with "Gamma" under the ring, the "+" and its tooltip sitting on a ring edge that is no longer the table's last rule), in all four contexts; Tab from the last cell, the append a seller makes most, the same (3 to 4 rows, `pos.h` 163 to 163 before and after Escape, the rows 216 px in the 163 px box, one Cmd+Z back to 3; dark 1280, the only context run after that step joined the drive). The "+" on the bottom edge grows the box (163 to 217) because `TableOverlay.tsx` `addAtEdge` writes its own `pos.h` through `edgeInsert`; the menu's command returns the plan's `block.set /rows` through the shell's `invoke` with no `pos.h` write and outside the stage's `withAutofit` (`Editor.tsx` 1684), and the session's append takes the same kind of path. OBJECTS.md 3.3 item 3 says a commit that leaves the rows taller than `pos.h` writes `pos.h` up in the same commit, "`commitCanvas`'s `withAutofit` for a command", so the feature does not do what the specification says on three of its four paths, and Kevin's screenshot state (the ring short of the table's rules) returns through the first row a seller adds. No row reads it: `tables.context.insert-delete` counts the rows, `tables.cell.tab-last-appends-row` counts the rows, `tables.rows.grow-with-text` types. For the fix round: the autofit on every table command and on the session's append (or the reducer writing `pos.h` from the rows), and a row "Insert row below from the cell's menu and Tab from the last cell write `pos.h` up in the same commit and the ring meets the last rule". Delete row leaves the box taller than the rows, which the rows share (3.3 item 3's rule), not a defect.
2. **Severity 1, B2 (`packages/viewer/src/table-fit.ts` `tableRowsNaturalHeight`) with B1 (the readout).** The resize handle's floor is the rows' natural (text) heights' sum while the rows' tracks floor at their set heights: on a table whose first row was set to 94 by the seam (rows 94, 54, 54, `pos.h` 203), the se handle dragged up by 240 read "960 × 163" at the tenth step (the empty rows' 163) and the release committed 203 (the autofit's write of the drawn rows), so the ring jumps 40 px at the release. On an empty table the two floors coincide and the row `tables.resize.rows-share-extra` reads green; the seller who set a row height sees the readout under the table's stop. Both 1440 contexts.
3. **Severity 2, B5 (`TableOverlay.tsx`: the "+" of the bottom edge over the seam under the last row) with B4 (`areas/tables.mjs` `tables.seam.row-drag`).** The seam handle under the last row (`handle.<table>.row.2`, the table's width by 9 px on the bottom rule) shares its band with the bottom edge's "+", which is drawn at the pointer along the edge above it (z-index 3) everywhere but the 14 px it keeps clear of the three squares, and with the `s` resize square at the centre; so a press on the seam meets the "+" (a click adds a row, a drag does nothing: `seam-probe.json` `row.2` at a quarter, at three quarters and at a tenth of the width, `under` the "+" and its svg) or the `s` square (a resize: the readout "960 × 183", the extra shared 66.3 across the rows, `rows[].height` unchanged), and the last row's own height can be dragged only inside the clear bands 6 to 14 px beside a square (`row.2` at 8 px from the corner and 8 px from the middle square: `rows[2]` 54 to 94, `pos.h` 163 to 203, the readout "74 px", the same as the inner seams from anywhere along their width). The walk's row presses the last seam at its centre and judges "the last seam grew the table" by the box, so it passes through the `s` square's resize. Google resizes the last row from anywhere on its bottom gridline; the "+" belongs under the rule, outside the seam's band, or the seam wins a vertical drag. A fix round item; the row's words hold (the table grows) while its mechanism is not the seam's.
4. **Severity 1, B4 (`areas/tables.mjs` `tables.select.ring-with-cell-open`) and a question for Kevin.** The driver holds Cmd through the band drag while the row's words read "moves the table by 80 by 40 exactly"; without Cmd the sheet's plate guide snaps the table's centre 3 px (the integrator's reproduction, `snap.ts`). The row passes against a driver its words do not describe; either the words name the snap or the plate lines stop snapping an object's centre (V.10).
5. **Severity 1, B5 (`menus/toolbar-tails.ts`, `TableOverlay.tsx`).** The new tooltips spell "colour" under controls labelled "Fill color" and "Border color" ("The colour of the letters, a theme colour or the ink"; "A theme colour, none, or a hex"): the chrome already carries both spellings (61 strings with colour, 253 with color), so the mix is the tree's, not the round's alone; a sweep to one spelling is one commit.

6. **Severity 2, the sync owner (`apps/studio/src/editor/EditorRoot.tsx` 676 to 689, `snap.access.role` and `snap.sync.overCeiling` on the blob tier).** On the preview's run 2, once the walk had retired its stalled deck (`untitled-20260926-zvu4`, "Reconnecting…" with revision 842 acknowledged, the window API's `block.insert` in the tables area never answering) and made a fresh one (`-xb9x`), the fresh deck opened in Editing mode for ten gestures rows and then every write through the window API was refused with "`block.insert` needs Editing mode; switch View > Mode to Editing for it" (the controller's viewer adapter, `controller.tsx` 4229), which `EditorRoot.tsx` forces when the answering instance reads the tab's role as viewer or the deck over its editing ceiling; the share and export sections then found "no filmstrip card title" and 183 rows read not driven. The round adds no store call and no sync path; the mechanism is the blob tier's lag on a deck seconds old (the vector round's V.5 finding 5, the first write against an instance behind the store), and a seller whose fresh deck lands on a lagging instance sees Viewing mode with no way back but a reload. Recorded, the stalled areas rerun once (V.3, V.4); for the sync owner: the forced mode should not follow a role or a ceiling the instance has not yet read for a deck this tab created.
7. **Severity 1, recorded (the harness under load).** Two runs of this pass were retired for the machine, not the product: the first 4439 gate (the memory tier's follower refusing a deck's writes after the brand deck's import, the integrator's class) and run 1 on the preview (the walk's headless tab crashed at row 361, "mouse.move: Target crashed", Playwright's internal error), both while another session's Playwright probes (arcade booths under a different scratchpad) held the one minute load at 100 to 120 with this pass's own four runs on top. The bounds of the blob tier's rows assume one gate at a time on this machine (the vector pass's V.10 item 4); this pass ran its gates serially after that.

8. **Severity 2, the sync owner (the blob tier's admission under lag; not this round's code).** In the same window on the preview, five readings counted one more of something than was written: the new write probe's first run (six edits landed at revision 13, one extra commit), `export.download.progress-per-slide` (a six slide deck read 7), `shapes.geometry.export.raster-modes` (4 slides for 3), `svg.export.pdf-vector` (3 for 2) and `sync.structural.concurrent` (3 blocks for 2), with `sync.resend.idempotent` red beside them (the resend's word read twice) and the two runs' walks refused by "This change no longer fits the slide after another change landed" (`fold-any-width`'s own write, the layout setup of run 2). The reading is a write acknowledged late and resent, then admitted a second time by an instance behind the store: a seller's doubled slide. The write probe's rerun and the specs' once rerun read them again (V.3, V.4); the vector pass's V.5 finding 5 named the first write against an instance behind the store; this pass names the resend.
9. **The two cost rows over, the sync owner (`docs/SYNC.md` 6.1).** `cost.editor-editing.calls` read 162 simple store calls a minute against 140 in run 2 (function requests 74.26 against 75, advanced 64 against 85; two instances answering, `lists.assets` 2 in the window's first sample) and `cost.two-tabs-idle.calls` one listing against none (`lists.assets` 1 in the first sample, advanced 14 against 30; the integrator's reading on both of its runs was the same listing): the JSON names the folder, `assets/`, the first open's listing of a tab landing after the probe's settle (2.2 to 2.4 s) and inside the window's first sample. The round adds no store call (V.2: no server, store or realtime file in the diff); the cost probe's once rerun alone on the preview (V.3, 13:01Z to 13:21Z) read every row under its ceiling: the editing row 69.93 function requests and 136 simple store calls a minute, the two tabs idle 0 listings and 18 advanced a minute, so both readings over were the store's load of their windows and the rows hold on this tree; the ship step's production gate reads them again as the integrator wrote.

## V.1 Verdict

**Not ready to ship.** The gate's verdict is failed on every tier and the hand re-walk found one defect a seller meets on the first slide of every deck: a title cannot be edited twice. After a title's first write, every later session on it is refused with the snackbar `text.splice: /heading is not a string on block "heading"` and the typed words leave on the next reload (V.5 finding 1; read by hand on the preview and on the memory tier, and by the collab audit's concurrent, offline and viewer rounds, whose title readings all came back empty). The mechanism is the integrator's seam of 14612488 (B1's request R4, POLISH.md item 19): the heading's text became a multiline value and the second session's splice refuses it. The walk never sees it because it reads the DOM, where the session's text stays until the reload.

What the round did land reads done in the pictures: Kevin's table (no prompt in a cell, the ring on the last rule while typing, the header rule only under a header with text, the caret moving on a click, a 20 by 20 landing at its full height, the edge "+" stopping at the content box, every one of the 100 grid sizes at y 218 with no wrapped prompt and no grown row: V.6 tables), the cloud callout closed, a press inside a shape under a connector moving the shape, the connectors following, no banner after the tab's own upload, the logo dialog's results in view with sentence case groups and the preselected tile marked, no plate under a logo, the border drawing on a colour pick with the heavier weights listed, the caption growing the box, the drop shadow drawing, the picture's panel in the seller's words, every menu row with a glyph, the Change shape and Mask plates inside the viewport, Format options with one Shape section and no line fields on a rectangle, the dialogs at their size with the focus inside, the Background dialog's thumbnails, Check slides' one table sentence, the new deck on the list at once and once, the link kept across a role change, the first Share reading Restricted, the print preview in the deck's appearance, the laser at 14 px, no captions button, one comment marker, the show's end plate, the concurrent New slide both kept, the offline words, the viewer link on the editor's floor, and the home page at the three widths in both appearances on the spacing of 3.4 with 4,898 px at 1440 and 1280 and 4,263 at 390, CLS 0, first byte 30 to 42 ms, every link 200 and `og:url` on the domain.

## V.5 Findings

Severity 3 a row broken or a feature that does not do what the specification says, 2 a defect a seller meets, 1 cosmetic or a recorded flake. Owners B1 to B7, the integrator or the sync owner. Pictures are under `docs/gslides-parity/polish/verify/` unless a path says otherwise.

### Severity 3

1. **A title cannot be edited twice: the second session's typing is refused and lost.** Every heading edit after the first write raises the snackbar `text.splice: /heading is not a string on block "heading"` and the typed words leave on the next reload. Read five ways: the hand drive on the preview (type, Escape, a double click on the title within 250 ms and again with 1.5 s between, more words, Escape, reload: `Onboarding plan for Acme` alone survives; `text-hand/13-reentry-fast.png`, `13-reentry-slow.png`), the same drive on the memory tier's 4449 (the same snackbar, the same loss), the collab audit's concurrent title rounds 2 and 3 (`final a: "", b: ""` while both stages showed the words; `collab/collab-ledger.json`), its offline round (`allFourMs` not within 30 s, headings `""`) and its viewer round (C never saw `cone`, `ctwo` or `cthree`). The subtitle and a text box keep their second edits (the same drive: `Prepared for the Acme team in Q3`, `Renewal terms for Acme and Globex` after a reload). Mechanism: the integrator's seam of 14612488 (B1's request R4, POLISH.md item 19) made the heading's `/text` a multiline pointer; the second session's `text.splice` refuses the stored value. Owner: the integrator with B1. Consequence: the ship waits; the title rows of the walk (`text.title.*`, `text.heading.enter-keeps-session`) and the sync title rows read the DOM and cannot see it. First reproduced at 13:31Z on the preview, when the first hand drive's title never reached the document and its highlight pick was refused as `text.mark: range 20..24 is outside a text` (`text-hand/02-highlight-amber-picked.png`, which also shows the refusal drawn as a JSON pointer sentence, POLISH.md item 59's rule).
2. **A shader's frame never lands on the blob tier.** God rays inserted at the content box on the preview: the frame's put answered 413 twice and 429 twice (the page's console), the sentence "The shader's frame could not be saved. Change the shader to try again" shows over a grey plate in the show (`media/c2-13-present-3s.png`), the PDF holds no image (`pdfimages -list` empty; `media/c2-pdf-page-2.png` blank) and the card draws the plate. Item 36's sentence landed; the presign path and the WebP fallback did not. `shaders.frame.large-png-lands` red on every tier. Owner: B4 with B5's capturer deps.
3. **Production's `/new` opened as a test template.** At 13:19Z `https://www.turboslide.com/new` and the preview drew the title `Brand spec deck` with the kit's primary `#0b3d91` (`store/production-new-before-reset.png`): the shared store's default template was `core-spec-template-mumbkll7`, saved and set by `brand.spec.ts` on the integrator's enforce previews, whose teardown resets the default only through a bearer the preview lacks (`resetDefaultThroughApi` returns false; the page path timed out). Reset by this pass at 13:23Z through production's bearer: `template.setDefault {id: blank}`, then `template.delete {confirm: true}` of `core-spec-template-mumbkll7`, `core-spec-template-mumbg9pa` and, at 14:05Z, the assist audit's own `polish-audit-njhk`; `template.list` reads blank and gt-brand with the default blank; production's `/new` read `Click to add title` again at 13:25Z and the preview's instances by 13:27Z. Every preview gate run without a hosts.json row for its origin leaves the same state behind. Owner: B6 (the spec's teardown must refuse to set a deployment default it cannot reset, or set it through the page before the bearer) and the verification owner (the hosts.json row for a preview origin).
4. **`present.link.first-paint-show` red twice on the preview** (the run of record and this pass's rerun on the final tree: `locator.waitFor` 30 s on the show's first paint). Not the blob tier's timing class. Owner: B5 (item 105).
5. **The new write probe fails two steps on the fresh preview** ("Duplicate slide after the save landed at the next revision: revision 14"; "the immediate keystroke reached the document"), as on the integrator's fifth and seventh previews; 25 other steps ok; the deck trashed and deleted forever. The blob tier's admission class (docs/SYNC.md 3.2). Owner: the sync owner.
6. **`decks.thumbnail.never-502` red twice on the preview** (150 s timeout both runs). The idle cost probe's request list shows the `/decks` listing asking `/api/render/<slide>` 243 times in 14 s for 98 cards (302, 404 and 200 answers), and the perf drive read `/decks` cold at 10.2 s, 6.8 s and 1.8 s with 46 to 77 console errors per load. Owner: B5 (items 90 and 111) with the sync owner; section 6's `/decks` load item stands.
7. **`share.name-prompt.first-share` (the name on the second browser's chip within 35 s), `collab.presence.join-within-2s`, `sync.serial.order-and-latency` ("a01 once in A"), `sync.structural.concurrent` (two positions after 5 s) and `sync.block.offline-replay-converges` red twice on the preview** (the run of record and this pass's rerun). The presence rows are B5's item 110 (A saw B's chip after 4.8 s and 5.3 s in the collab audit's two runs); the sync rows the blob tier's admission class. Owner: B5 and the sync owner.

## V.1 Verdict

**Not ready to ship.** The fix round did what it set out to do: 21 of pass 1's 30 severity 3 and 2 findings read fixed by hand on the fresh enforce preview and on the memory tier (the table under V.5), the new write probe reads 27 of 27, the bursts three of three clean, the idle editor 9.66 function requests a minute against 12, and Kevin's table, the shader frame, the logo refit, the versions panel, the filmstrip's Home and the toolbar's live paragraph writes all read done in their pictures. Both gates still read failed with retries zero: the memory tier 1019 rows, 915 passed, 80 failed, 24 not driven; the enforce preview 897 passed, 82 failed, 40 not driven; the once reruns of POLISH.md 5.2 turned 8 spec rows and one walk row green (flaky, recorded) and left 17 spec rows and 7 walk rows red twice. The ship waits on four things (V.5 findings 1 to 4): a title that wraps now converts the cover to a canvas, and New slide after such a cover makes a second title slide while Skip title slides stops skipping it (four `slides` rows green in pass 1 and red on both tiers now; read by hand); the four driver requests of the fix round that nobody landed keep rows of `text` and `share` red while the product reads right by hand; a title's Cmd+Z takes back part of the title in about one session of three (a mechanism older than the round, read for the first time on the memory tier); and `origin/main` moved eleven commits past the merge base, nine of them not in `polish/round`, so the ship's tree is a merge no gate has read. Beside those: the chip's click no longer jumps to a collaborator's slide (`collab.roster.go-to-slide`, green in pass 1, red on both tiers and the rerun: finding 5), alt text's focus is still lost on the blob tier (finding 10), Bulleted list on the title is still refused (finding 8), `images.options.reset` still writes nothing (finding 11), and the rows of the parkable features that pass 1 read red on the preview read red again (V.4). The machine's load through the pass was another project's Playwright suite: a one minute load of 26 to 47 in the first hour, 60 to 130 through the spec phases and 260 to 520 between 00:10Z and 01:10Z, which the timing rows read (the memory tier's cost row `cost.editor-editing.calls` 80.55 against 75, `decks.thumbnail.never-502`'s 150 s, the resize spec's one row, all named in V.5 finding 22).

### Severity 3

1. **New slide after a title that wraps makes a second title slide, and the slide counter's Skip title slides no longer skips it.** A consequence of finding 1's fix: the placeholder shrink's converting write, which the old seam refused, now lands, so a cover whose title wraps becomes a canvas (`kind content`, `grammar.kind title`, `template title`), and every rule that finds the cover by `slide.kind === 'title'` stops seeing it. Read by hand on 4449 (`objects/slides-hand2.mjs`, `text-hand/slides-long-new-slide.png`): after `Onboarding plan for Acme in ninety days with the partner desk and every regional lead` the cover reads `kind content, grammar.kind title`, and the toolbar's New slide makes `title-1-fa36`, a title slide with the mark, "Click to add title" and "Click to add subtitle"; after `Onboarding plan` the cover stays `kind title` and New slide makes `split-1`, Title and body. The walk reads it on both tiers: `slides.layout.title-and-body-single` ("layout title; prompts Click to add title, Click to add subtitle", the four lines typed into the subtitle: the gate's shot `101-slides.layout.title-and-body-single-failed.png`), `slides.layout.new-slide-inherits` ("New slide after the title slide title"), `slides.layout.subtitle-prompt` and `slides.numbers.apply` ("title slide kind content"; the counter on the cover reads "01 / 05" after Skip title slides), all four green in pass 1 on 4449 and red now on 4449 and on the preview. The sites: `packages/chrome/src/editor-shell.ts` 2592 (`slide.kind === 'title' ? 'split' : derivedLayout(slide)`), `packages/chrome/src/Filmstrip.tsx` 182 (`newSlideLayout`), `packages/render/src/deck.ts` 72 (`mode === 'skip-title' && slide.kind === 'title'`); the reducer's `deckTitleSource` and the fix's `retargetFieldRuns` already read a converted cover through its grammar record's kind, and these three do not (`logo-model.ts` 447 and `FindReplace.tsx` 46 and 99 read `kind` the same way and were not driven). Owner: the integrator (the conversion the fix made reachable) with B1 (`editor-shell.ts`) and B5 (`Filmstrip.tsx`, `packages/render` is the integrator's). Consequence: `slides` is unparkable; the ship waits.
2. **The four driver requests of the fix round that no one landed leave rows of unparkable features red in the run of record.** `text.paragraph.toolbar-live` and `text.list.enter-tab-no-error` (B1's R22a: the text nodes' rects and Double instead of 1.5; `items[1].level >= 2`), `collab.follow.anonymous-editor` (B5's R13 to the integrator: `title.presence.follow` still `advanced: true` in `model.ts` 796, so the roster row reads Go to slide in the default view and the spec cannot read Follow), `tables.insert.one-placement-rule` and `tables.insert.box-never-shorter-than-rows` (B2's R11: `pickTable` takes the converted title as the table), `present.link.first-paint-show` (B5's R12: the Present link the dialog mints instead of a stranger's direct address), `shaders.frame.large-png-lands` (B4's F5: the show's visible sheet and the plate's own colour), `diagrams.label.double-click-selects-word` (the one space), `wordart.polish.chip-weight-arming` (the letters' weight through the `b` elements), `help.check-slides.plain-sentence` (the `li` and its button counted twice), `text.bold.toolbar-marks-run`, `text.tail.size-reads-heading`, `text.title.shrink-on-overflow`, `text.autofit.title-wraps`, `text.link.detection-setting`, `chrome.chip.above-ring` (pass 1's finding 37).
